audit.summary: Asset audit passed. Six assets total: 1 logo (valid brand asset) and 5 usable product assets with distinct SKUs across packshots and lifestyle scenes. No duplicate primary_product_name values. Sufficient variety for retail HTML5 ad generation. The logos/brand-lego.svg file displays the official LEGO® wordmark with correct brand identity. The iconic red background, yellow outline, white letterforms with black stroke, and registered trademark symbol (®) all match the established LEGO brand guidelines and primary color palette (#E3000B red, #FFED00 yellow, #000000 black, #FFFFFF white). This is a legitimate official LEGO wordmark suitable for the LEGO® Pokémon™ collaboration campaign.
